question.name: 端侧 AI 推理性能优化与 seekdb 混合检索

backends.note: Test host has no GPU so the executed path is WASM; when navigator.gpu + adapter exist the app uses WebGPU. Force-gpu without WebGPU raises an explicit error instead of silently degrading.

database.fulltext_index: CREATE FULLTEXT INDEX ix_chunks_fts ON chunks (content) WITH PARSER SPACE
database.vector_index: CREATE VECTOR INDEX ix_chunks_vec ON chunks (embedding) WITH (type=hnsw, distance=l2)
database.hybrid_search: SELECT DBMS_HYBRID_SEARCH.SEARCH('chunks', body); body carries query.match.content + knn.query_vector + rank.rrf

checks.name: full-pipeline: import -> embed -> write seekdb -> query -> ranked results
checks.evidence: docs/evidence.md §1: MODEL 1121ms; IMPORT batch1 +8 chunks; SEARCH 5 hits/22ms; IMPORT2 +2 chunks (11 total); AFTER-REFRESH 5 hits

checks.name: local inference: no cloud embedding API
checks.evidence: allowRemoteModels=false + external DNS blocked: OFFLINE-ENCODE dims=384 in 181ms, EXTERNAL REQUESTS 0

checks.name: quantization: INT8 with size/quality comparison
checks.evidence: 86.20 MB -> 21.91 MB (3.93x); 25.30 -> 23.30 ms per text; Top-5 agreement vs FP32 = 94% (10 queries)

checks.name: WebGPU preferred, automatic WASM fallback with UI notice
checks.evidence: detectDevice() in web/app.js; #deviceVal shows WASM and #fallbackNotice banner on this GPU-less host; force-gpu raises explicit error

checks.name: seekdb stores vectors/text/metadata; hybrid retrieval inside seekdb
checks.evidence: one /api/search -> one DBMS_HYBRID_SEARCH.SEARCH; generated SQL displayed on page; renderHits() only renders order

checks.name: incremental import + refresh: newly imported batch searchable
checks.evidence: batch2 import + page reload -> 11 chunks / 2 batch; batch2 content returned

checks.name: reproducibility: documented start of app + database
compliance: no cloud inference / no server precompute / no seekdb bypass
performance: measured before/after with medians
checks.evidence: performance-results.json (batch encode 93.7 -> 62.4 ms; retrieval p50 8.3 ms / max 18.1 ms)

environment.host: cloud vm, 4 vCPU (2 cores), 4 GB RAM, no GPU

summary.notes: All figures come from runs of this repository on the host above; no hand-written or server-side precomputed vectors are used.
